🎥🎬: Beauty in Black (2024–Present)

Kimmie is a young woman struggling to survive after being forced into difficult circumstances. Her life changes when she becomes connected to a wealthy and powerful family whose glamorous lifestyle hides a world of secrets, betrayal, and dangerous ambitions.

As Kimmie becomes entangled with the family and their beauty empire, she discovers that everyone has something to hide. Surrounded by rivalries, manipulation, romance, and power struggles, she must learn to navigate the dangerous world around her while fighting for control of her own future.
